definition_quote.value: a person who holds oneself out as able to perform, or who does perform, any professional service such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, including aesthetic and structural design, or observation of construction, in connection with any private or public buildings, structures, or projects or the equipment or utilities thereof, or the accessories thereto, wherein the safeguarding of life, health, or property is concerned or involved, when the professional service requires the application of the art and science of construction based upon the principles of mathematics, aesthetics, and the physical sciences.
definition_quote.quote: a person who holds oneself out as able to perform, or who does perform, any professional service such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, including aesthetic and structural design, or observation of construction, in connection with any private or public buildings, structures, or projects or the equipment or utilities thereof, or the accessories thereto, wherein the safeguarding of life, health, or property is concerned or involved, when the professional service requires the application of the art and science of construction based upon the principles of mathematics, aesthetics, and the physical sciences.

methods_authorized.quote: any professional service such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, including aesthetic and structural design, or observation of construction

permitted_firm_structures.quote: A corporation or copartnership may engage in the practice of professional engineering, architecture, surveying, or landscape architecture in the State if the person or persons connected with the corporation or copartnership directly in charge of the professional work is duly licensed.

seal_required.quote: All plans, specifications, maps, and reports prepared by or under the supervision of a licensed engineer, architect, surveyor, or landscape architect shall be stamped with such seal or stamp when filed with public officials.

seal_surrender_required_on_license_termi.quote: It shall be unlawful for anyone to seal or stamp any document with such seal or stamp after the license has expired or has been revoked or suspended unless such license has been renewed or reissued.

continuing_education_subject_requirement.quote: All continuing education courses shall be relevant to public protection subjects and shall be approved by the board as provided in the board's rules

value: Member of the armed forces, National Guard, or reserve component on active duty and deployed during a state or national crisis
Ill or disabled for a significant period of time as documented by a licensed physician
Undue hardship that prevented the licensee from meeting the continuing education requirements
Retired from the practice of architecture and no longer performing or providing architectural services
continuing_education_waiver_conditions.quote: An architect licensee shall not be subject to the continuing education requirement if the architect otherwise meets all other renewal requirements and: (A) Is a member of the armed forces, National Guard, or a reserve component on active duty and deployed during a state or national crisis; (B) Is ill or disabled for a significant period of time as documented by a licensed physician; (C) Can demonstrate undue hardship that prevented the licensee from meeting the continuing education requirements; or (D) Is retired from the practice of architecture and is no longer performing or providing architectural services

value: Privately owned or privately controlled one-storied building or structure with estimated cost not exceeding $40,000
Privately controlled two-storied building or structure with estimated cost not exceeding $35,000
Privately owned or privately controlled one-storied residence with estimated cost not exceeding $180,000
Privately owned or privately controlled two-storied residence with cost not exceeding $162,000
exempt_building_types.quote: The provisions of this chapter shall not apply to work in respect to any privately owned or privately controlled one-storied building or structure, the estimated cost of which does not exceed $40,000, nor to any privately controlled two-storied building or structure, the estimated cost of which does not exceed $35,000.

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.value: Fine not more than $500 or imprisonment not more than one year, or both (misdemeanor)
unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.quote: shall be fined not more than $500 or imprisoned not more than one year, or both.

civil_penalty_maximum.quote: Any licensee who violates this chapter or the rules adopted pursuant thereto may also be fined not less than $500 nor more than $1,000 per violation.
